You are carrying a china mans disguise and your money.
 Major Percival Ffoulkes remarks to you" Well Holmes you have found out my shameful secret, I am addicted to this vile opium and I confess, this is where I was last night.".

You go south.
 You are on Slater Street. It is too dark to see much else.
 Watson says to you" Good evening ".
Major Percival Ffoulkes enters.

Inspector Lestrade enters.
 Inspector Lestrade says to you" Hello".
 Inspector Lestrade says" Very good Holmes, I shall return to Leather head tomorrow to have another look around. Inspector Lestrade says to Watson" Good evening ".
 Watson says to Inspector Lestrade" Hello".

Inspector Lestrade remarks to Major Percival Ffoulkes" You are free to go.".
 Inspector Lestrade hails the hansom cab.
 Major Percival Ffoulkes goes north.
 The cabbie says to Inspector Lestrade" Hello guv'nor.".
Inspector Lestrade climbs into the hansom cab.
Inspector Lestrade says to the cabbie" Go to Parliament Street.".

You hail the hansom cab.
 The cabbie remarks to you" Good morning guv'nor.".

You climb into the hansom cab.
 Watson climbs into the hansom cab.

You talk to the cabbie.
 You are in a hansom cab with Watson and the cabbie. Watson is carrying the daily chronicle and some bloodstained clothes. You are travelling the streets of London in a hansom cab, the sun shines through the windows onto your face.
You wait.
You wait.
You wait.
You wait.

You are in a hansom cab. The hansom cab is in Portman Street. To the south there is tricias front door.
 The cabbie remarks to you" Right guv'nor that will be 10d."
You wait.
You pay 10d. To the cabbie.

You get out of the hansom cab.
 Watson climbs out of the hansom cab.
Tricia Fender enters.
Tricia Fender opens tricias front door.
Tricia Fender goes through tricias front door.
